annotations.title: Bundle agent events for an offline check

description: Gather agent events recorded from this machine, with their proofs and salts, into one file (augmentev/fabric-agent-events/v1) that anyone can check offline with `augmentev-verify agent-events`. Free. Fetch each event's proof with get_proof first. The file discloses the events' contents to whoever receives it. It shows the bundled events, not that the bundle holds every event: completeness comes from the account's governance export.

run_id.description: Bundle every saved event of this run.
